title: DLMF 4.14 Definitions and Periodicity: The functions \sin z and \cos z are entire.
summary: DLMF 4.14 Definitions and Periodicity: The functions \sin z and \cos z are entire.
body: NIST DLMF section 4.14 (Definitions and Periodicity) says: "The functions \sin z and \cos z are entire. In \mathbb{C} the zeros of \sin z are z=k\pi , k\in\mathbb{Z} ; the zeros of \cos z are z=\left(k+\tfrac{1}{2}\right)\pi , k\in\mathbb{Z} . The functions \tan z , \csc z , \sec z , and \cot z are meromorphic, and the locations of their zeros and poles follow from ( 4.14.4 ) to ( 4.14.7 )." This card records that section's wording and equation alt text. It does not retypeset a formula the alt text did not carry.
